products.title: Power up Handy Emergency Smart Phone Charger
products.description: The Power Up Handy Emergency Smart Phone Charger is a compact, portable power solution designed for emergency use. It features a cylindrical battery pack and comes with three adapters to ensure compatibility with a wide range of smartphones, including iPhones Generation 5 and newer. In addition to the included battery pack, the USB charger cable allows the device to be powered by computers, car chargers, and most wall outlet chargers, making it a versatile accessory for users on the go.

products.title: ChargeTab Emergency USB -C Phone Charger
products.description: The ChargeTab Emergency USB-C Phone Charger is a compact, pre-charged portable battery designed for instant backup power. It provides up to 4 hours of standby power for USB-C compatible devices and is an ideal solution for travel, commuting, or unexpected emergencies when a traditional power source is unavailable. This device is non-rechargeable and comes ready to use with no additional cables required.

products.title: Nano Charger (20W)
products.description: The Anker PowerPort PD Nano is an ultra-compact 20W USB-C fast wall charger designed for high-speed charging of mobile devices. Measuring just over 1 inch on each side, it provides power equivalent to a standard 5W charger but with significantly higher efficiency, capable of charging flagship iPhones to 50% in approximately 30 minutes. It features universal compatibility with iPhone, Samsung, and select USB-C laptops like the MacBook Air, and includes the MultiProtect safety system for temperature control and voltage protection.
